cards.ex: The company was debt-ridden and on the verge of bankruptcy.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya qarzlarga botgan edi va bankrotlik yoqasida edi.
cards.uzDef: Qarzlari juda ko'p bo'lgan, qarzga botgan.

cards.ex: I'm a bit stuck for cash this month; could you cover dinner?
cards.exUz: Men bu oy biroz pul topishga qiynalyapman; kechki ovqatni to'laysizmi?
cards.uzDef: Tezda pul topishda qiynalish, pulga muhtoj bo'lish.

cards.ex: With the recession looming, we need to tighten the purse strings.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy inqiroz yaqinlashar ekan, biz xarajatlarni qisqartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish, pulni tejashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: After selling his company, he was flush with cash.
cards.exUz: O'z kompaniyasini sotgandan so'ng, u pulga to'la edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p pulga ega bo'lish, pul bilan ta'minlangan bo'lish.

cards.ex: The bank offered us a substantial line of credit to expand our business.
cards.exUz: Bank bizga biznesimizni kengaytirish uchun sezilarli kredit liniyasini taklif qildi.
cards.uzDef: Bank tomonidan beriladigan kredit limit, pul olish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: The government approved a multi-billion dollar bailout package for the banks.
cards.exUz: Hukumat banklar uchun bir necha milliard dollarlik qutqaruv paketini ma'qulladi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat yoki tashkilot tomonidan moliyaviy yordam ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: The museum is cash-strapped and facing closure.
cards.exUz: Muzey pulga muhtoj va yopilish xavfi ostida.
cards.uzDef: Pul etishmasligi, moliyaviy qiyinchilikda bo'lish.

cards.ex: They invested in high-yield investments but lost a lot of money.
cards.exUz: Ular yuqori daromadli investitsiyalarga sarmoya kiritdilar, ammo ko'p pul yo'qotdilar.
cards.uzDef: Katta foyda keltiradigan investitsiya, risk yuqori bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: She deposited her savings in an interest-bearing account.
cards.exUz: U o'z jamg'armasini foizli hisob raqamiga qo'ydi.
cards.uzDef: Pul saqlangan hisob raqami, pulga foiz qo'shiladi.

cards.ex: Solar power is becoming increasingly cost-effective.
cards.exUz: Quyosh energiyasi tobora tejamli bo'lib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Pulga nisbatan foydali, arzon va samarali.

cards.ex: They were living beyond their means and accumulated huge debts.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z imkoniyatlaridan tashqari yashashdi va katta qarzlar to'plashdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z daromadidan ko'proq xarajat qilish.

cards.ex: Remember, a penny saved is a penny earned.
cards.exUz: Esda tuting, tejagan - topgan.
cards.uzDef: Ozgina tejash ham foyda, pulni tejash muhim.

cards.ex: I did a balance transfer to get a lower interest rate.
cards.exUz: Men pastroq foiz stavkasini olish uchun qoldiq o'tkazmasini qildim.
cards.uzDef: Kredit kartadagi qarzni boshqa kartaga ko'chirish.

cards.ex: Only creditworthy customers will be approved for a loan.
cards.exUz: Faqat kreditga loyiq mijozlarga kredit olishga ruxsat beriladi.
cards.uzDef: Kredit olish uchun ishonchli, qarzni qaytarish qobiliyatiga ega.

cards.ex: Day trading is a risky way to invest.
cards.exUz: Kunduzgi savdo - sarmoya kiritishning xavfli usuli.
cards.uzDef: Bir kun ichida aktsiyalarni sotib olish va sotish.

cards.ex: The company's fiscal year ends in December.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning moliyaviy yili dekabrda tugaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat yoki kompaniya uchun bir yillik moliyaviy davr.

cards.ex: He decided to go for broke and invest all his savings.
cards.exUz: U borini tikishga va barcha jamg'armalarini sarmoya qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsani riskga qo'yish, katta xavfga borish.

cards.ex: The country needs to earn more hard currency to pay its debts.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat qarzlarini to'lash uchun ko'proq qattiq valyuta topishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Barqaror va keng tarqalgan valyuta (masalan, AQSh dollari).

cards.ex: He invested in junk bonds hoping for a quick profit.
cards.exUz: U tezda foyda olish umidida keraksiz obligatsiyalarga sarmoya kiritdi.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori riskli, lekin yuqori daromadli obligatsiyalar.

cards.ex: The central bank acts as the lender of last resort.
cards.exUz: Markaziy bank oxirgi umid beruvchi sifatida ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Moliyaviy qiyinchilikka duch kelgan banklarga yordam beradigan tashkilot.

cards.ex: He was accused of hiding money in offshore accounts.
cards.exUz: U chet el hisob raqamlarida pul yashirishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Chet elda ochilgan hisob raqami, soliqlardan qochish uchun.

cards.ex: We're working hard to pay down our debt.
cards.exUz: Biz qarzimizni kamaytirish uchun qattiq ishlayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Qarzni asta-sekin to'lash, qarz miqdorini kamaytirish.

cards.ex: The central bank implemented quantitative easing to stimulate the economy.
cards.exUz: Markaziy bank iqtisodiyotni rag'batlantirish uchun miqdoriy yumshatishni amalga oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Markaziy bank tomonidan pul massasini ko'paytirish siyosati.

cards.ex: The company is looking for new revenue streams.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi daromad oqimlarini qidirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Daromad manbai, pul keladigan yo'l.

cards.ex: I have a savings account for emergencies.
cards.exUz: Menda favqulodda vaziyatlar uchun jamg'arma hisobi bor.
cards.uzDef: Pulni saqlash uchun ochilgan hisob raqami.

cards.ex: He took a bath on the stock market crash.
cards.exUz: U fond bozori qulashi natijasida pulini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Pulni yo'qotish, zarar ko'rish (moliyaviy).

cards.ex: He was paid under the table to avoid taxes.
cards.exUz: U soliq to'lashdan qochish uchun yashirincha to'langan.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy bo'lmagan yo'l bilan, yashirincha to'lash.

cards.ex: They raised venture capital to start their business.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z bizneslarini boshlash uchun risklik kapital yig'ishdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi kompaniyalarga beriladigan sarmoya, xavf yuqori.

cards.ex: The company used window dressing to hide its financial problems.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya moliyaviy muammolarini yashirish uchun ko'zbo'yamachilik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Holatni yaxshi ko'rsatish uchun qilingan harakat.

cards.ex: Negotiations shouldn't be a zero-sum game.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar nol yig'indili o'yin bo'lmasligi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir tarafning yutug'i boshqasining yo'qotishi.
